name: bluebridge-sites
description: Plan marketing and edit websites with fast local workspaces or hosted previews. Save batches to Sites; human approval and publication stay separate.

defaultPrompt: Help me prioritize my marketing content
interface.longDescription: Plan marketing and save working plans, decisions and content priorities with explicit consent. In capable desktop environments, iterate on a local website folder and preview, then save a revision-checked batch to Sites. Other environments use hosted editing and previews. Resume shared work across conversations; unsent local changes stay on that computer. Actions require configured backend capabilities and current access. Binary uploads, page deletion/renaming, analytics ingestion and social publishing remain unavailable. Human review, approval and publication stay separate.
